title: Fourteen Editions and One Wrong Number
subtitle: 信息与索引 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 信息与索引（科学与技术·信息与索引）
meta: 主题语境：信息与索引（科学与技术·信息与索引）　|　核心词汇：directory　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 directory 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1952 the compiler ① produced a directory that no office in the town would have bought, and he said the producing was the whole of the year. The ② directory, meaning the list and not the book, ran fourteen editions and stayed unchecked in the proof; a directory, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how long it is left uncorrected.

Every ③ directory in that shelf had the same wrong number at the foot of it, and the ④ directory at the end, meaning the one they kept for the trade names and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever checked twice. A directory, his assistant said, is nine parts checking and one part somebody willing to produce; the compiler said the checking is the part that fills fourteen editions.

The librarian meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the directory was the whole of the counter, meaning the book and not the list. The ⑥ directory, meaning the book and not any of that, is the only thing on a counter that everybody consults and nobody reads; directory, she said, is either something you produce or the only word that means both a list and a book. She said the book is the part they remember.

By 1960 the ⑦ directory had become a line in a catalogue, and the catalogue had become an argument about the wrong number. The ⑧ directory of the whole thing, the compiler wrote in August, was one shelf and fourteen editions of checking; directory, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to check. She said the checking was never mentioned.

The ⑨ directory I remember is the one at the end, which was corrected in 1974 and is still described as the fullest in the town. A ⑩ directory, the assistant said in 1976, is the only thing that improves by being checked; every directory, she said, is a book that has agreed to look like a list. She said the book was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 名录；号码簿（指书架上编成的那一部）
B. n. 名录（指那份名单本身，与那本书相对）
C. 固定搭配：produce a directory 编出一本名录
D. n. 名录（指留给商号名用的那一部）
E. n. 名录；索引（抽象总称，指一架书的全部名录之编）
F. n. 名录（指书目上写到、被列名的那一部）
G. n. 名录册；电话簿（指柜台上摆着的那本书）
H. n. 名录册（抽象总称，指人人查阅却无人细读的那本）

items.q: produced a directory that no office in the town would have bought
The directory, meaning the list and not the book
the directory was the whole of the counter
the directory had become a line in a catalogue
The directory of the whole thing
A directory, the assistant said in 1976

answers.why: produce a directory 意为“编出一本名录”，1952 年编纂者编出了一本全镇没有一家事务所肯买的名录。
directory 意为“名录”，指那份名单本身而不是那本书，它历经十四个版次而在校样上没有校对。
directory 意为“名录、号码簿”，指那架书里每一部名录，每一部页脚都有同一个错误的号码。
directory 意为“名录”，指留给商号名用的那一部，是唯一有人核过两次的。
directory 意为“名录册、电话簿”，指柜台上摆着的那本书，馆员说这本书就是那个柜台的全部。
directory 意为“名录册”，指人人查阅却无人细读的那本而不是那份名单，是柜台上人人都查阅、却无人细读的东西。
directory 意为“名录”，指书目上写到、被列名的那一部，到 1960 年这部名录成了书目里的一行。
directory 意为“名录、索引”，编纂者八月写道，整件事的名录之编是一架书和十四个版次的校对。
directory 意为“名录”，我记得的是末尾那一部，1974 年被更正，至今仍被说成全镇最完备的。
directory 为抽象总称，助手 1976 年说，一部名录是唯一会因为被校对而变得更好的东西。
